seed_protocol: first128 bits, big endian, SHA256(UTF8('C-NBI-v2/phase10c/v1/{master}/{key}/{role}')); PCG64; no global RNG or processing-order counters
true_objectives: f_j(x)=sum_k(x_k-a_jk)^2, all MIN; exact Phase10A anchors only
pareto_set: conv(frozen anchors), contained in original ball
replica_references: one common reference per structural cell, shared by all five replicas

geometry.qhull_options: Qc Qx; implicit Qt; never QJ
geometry.uniform_volume_method: volume-weighted centroid cones to triangulated hull facets; uniform sorted-spacings simplex barycentric weights
geometry.fallback: redundant-anchor Dirichlet plus all nx-anchor subsimplex strata; explicitly nonuniform, requires review; no anchor perturbation

candidates.identity: L-infinity <=1e-12*alpha, first stable source ID; no transitive clustering

selection.space: Euclidean normalized true objectives; objective-coverage oriented, not uniform volume
selection.tie: first original candidate source ID for exact numeric ties

coverage_review.rationale: 1/20 of true Pareto response range in coordinate RMS; finite audit convention, not asymptotic convergence or uniform approximation theorem
coverage_review.failure: REVIEW_REQUIRED before10D; never change official5000 or tune sampling

dominance.reference: analytic convex-combination certificate; retain apparent tolerance-dominated points and diagnose

metrics.GD_IGD: p1 arithmetic mean of Euclidean nearest-neighbor distances
metrics.Spacing: sample SD ddof1 of Euclidean nearest-other distances

hypervolume_study.tier_selection: start16;if any primary reference fails precision,study all at18,then20;one global final level;unresolved at20 stays pending
hypervolume_study.seeds: key=hv_m{m},role=scramble_{0..3}; same quadrature for every method/replica
hypervolume_study.indicator: validated HVGrid quadrature; exact orthant-union tree acceleration
hypervolume_study.final_resolution: freeze after reference/oracle study; unresolved regimes remain explicit, never fabricated

evaluation.raw_decisions: preserved unchanged, with original row IDs
evaluation.secondary: plan only, minimum eligible size per paired cell/replica; candidate-only geometry, no reference distances or interpolation

figures.nearest_neighbor_outliers: not drawn; full minima/maxima retained in tables
figures.coverage_display: coordinate-RMS-normalized Euclidean distances; metric GD/IGD remain unscaled
